findings.explanation: Steps 1-5 are duplicated at the end with generic modular input/HEC boilerplate that contradicts the earlier Juniper syslog instructions.
findings.quote:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (`Splunk_TA_juniper`, syslog — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=juniper:junos:structured into network. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the appended generic template block and retain only the Juniper-specific configuration steps.
